tech.summary: Amazon's cloud unit AWS posted its fastest growth in nearly five years, rising 39% to $46 billion in Q3, yet the stock dropped more than 7% in extended trading after Amazon forecast Q4 revenue of $240–247 billion, largely below Wall Street estimates. The company kept its annual capital spending forecast at about $220 billion as it races to build AI data centers.
tech.title: Amazon's AWS grows 39% to $46B — but shares still fell over 7%

tech.summary: Microsoft's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 19% to $92.28 billion with Azure growing 48%, and shares gained about 3% after hours. But AI infrastructure is consuming capital faster than operations replace it, so reports say Microsoft plans to issue at least $25 billion in bonds to fund data center buildouts — alongside a 60,000-employee voluntary exit program.
tech.title: Microsoft's Azure jumps 48% — and it's borrowing $25B to build faster

tech.summary: Alphabet's Q3 revenue rose 25% to $127.6 billion, but earnings missed Wall Street for the first time in nearly four years. Google Cloud doubled to $30.7 billion while search grew just 12% as AI Mode queries monetize slower; capex hit $51.36 billion, pushing quarterly free cash flow to negative $9.07 billion. Gemini has now passed one billion users.
tech.title: Alphabet's cloud doubles to $30.7B, but search slows and cash flow goes negative

tech.summary: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 — nicknamed 'Le Chonk' — a 1-trillion-parameter, natively multimodal model trained on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs in its own European data centers. It claims the top open-weight score on FrontierCode 2.0 and a 96.6% refusal rate on malicious cyber requests, under a modified MIT license that lets anyone use and commercialize it.
tech.title: Mistral opens the weights on its 1-trillion-parameter flagship model

tech.summary: Nvidia is in talks to offer AI cloud provider Nscale billions of dollars in credit guarantees to support debt funding for a data center in West Virginia earmarked for Anthropic, The Information reported. Anthropic already struck a deal in August to spend $45 billion renting computing power from the campus, as debt financing behind the AI buildout faces growing scrutiny.
tech.title: Nvidia in talks to back Nscale's Anthropic data center with credit guarantees

tech.summary: OpenAI updated its Model Spec — the public document describing how its models should behave — reorganizing it around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The revision adds guidance on context, oversight and agency, and retires most of the detailed style guidance.
tech.title: OpenAI rewrites its Model Spec around five values

pakistan.summary: Singapore's Minister for Foreign Affairs Dr Vivian Balakrishnan undertakes an official visit to Islamabad today at the invitation of Deputy PM Ishaq Dar. The visit coincides with the 60th anniversary of diplomatic relations and comes ahead of Singapore assuming the Asean chairmanship in 2027; an MoU on disaster management cooperation will also be exchanged.
pakistan.title: Singapore's foreign minister visits Islamabad today on 60 years of ties

pakistan.summary: Lahore topped the world for hazardous air on Thursday with an AQI of 419, while Karachi ranked eighth at 165. A Pakistan Air Quality Initiative study says toxic air cuts life expectancy across Pakistan by an estimated 3.9 years, drives roughly 128,000 premature deaths a year, and costs about 6.5% of GDP — with vehicles the top PM2.5 source in Lahore.
pakistan.title: Lahore named world's most polluted city as smog cuts life expectancy

pakistan.summary: Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal said goods exports rose 7.7% to $8.5 billion in July–September FY2026-27, combined goods and services exports reached $11.2 billion, ICT exports hit $1.2 billion, and workers' remittances grew 14% to $10.9 billion — despite disruptions in global markets and supply chains.
pakistan.title: Exports up 7.7% to $8.5B, remittances up 14% to $10.9B in first quarter

pakistan.summary: The finance ministry's October Economic Update warns that Gulf tensions, volatile oil prices, trade disruptions and elevated global inflation are downside risks for the economy, projecting October inflation at 9.5–10.5%. It says the current account deficit stood at $874 million in Jul–Sep FY2027, with remittances more than covering the combined goods and services trade deficit.
pakistan.title: Govt warns Gulf conflict and oil volatility threaten growth, sees inflation at 9.5–10.5%

pakistan.summary: The PPP has called for a parliamentary committee to discuss electoral reforms, saying it wants elections free, fair and transparent. Senior leader Raja Pervaiz Ashraf said Bilawal Bhutto Zardari raised the issue, that the PPP wants PTI to join standing committees and the proposed committee, and that PTI will convey its position after internal consultations.
pakistan.title: PPP wants a parliamentary committee on electoral reforms — and PTI at the table

pakistan.summary: The ICC reprimanded and fined Pakistan fast bowler Haris Rauf 20% of his match fee for a code of conduct breach during Sunday's tri-series match against England in Lahore, which Pakistan won by one wicket. One demerit point takes his tally to five in 24 months; England were also fined 15% for a slow over rate. Pakistan and Sri Lanka contest Saturday's final in Lahore.
pakistan.title: ICC fines Haris Rauf 20% of match fee over conduct in England tri-series game
